name: podium
description: Mission control for coding agents — run, observe, and steer Claude Code, Codex, and other agent CLIs from one self-hosted web UI.

scripts.//build: Every package's build is a Turbo task; this only delegates (POD-3053). It was a hand-written `bun run --filter` chain, which is how POD-1610 survived a night of rebuilding: the chain looked like it rebuilt everything and left apps/web/dist three days stale. A chain has to be remembered; a task graph does not. Both clients are in it now, and an unchanged one is restored from the shared cache instead of rebuilt. apps/desktop is NOT: `@podium/desktop build` is a Tauri release build needing a Rust toolchain, it is a separately released artefact this server never serves, and it stays on `desktop:build`. This goes through scripts/build-clients.ts so the run carries the same admission and the same PODIUM_CHECK_ENV_HASH as every other cached lane — a raw `turbo run build` would be a different cache key, reusing nothing and filling the shared cache under an unfingerprinted identity.
scripts.//build:clients: The client build lane: `turbo run build` for both clients under admission, reporting each task's hash and whether it was restored. What scripts/build-bun.ts calls when it packages a release.
scripts.//deps:global-store-cache-admission: One heavy-test lease around the WHOLE lane, not per probe. The lane runs several cold typechecks and package tests in disposable worktrees, and it unsets PODIUM_SESSION_ID inside them because `podium lock` cannot name a holder from a detached worktree — so no inner probe can take a lease of its own and the lane would otherwise burn the box unadmitted (POD-2774).
scripts.deps:global-store-cache-admission: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts heavy --label deps:global-store-cache-admission -- bun scripts/global-store-cache-admission.ts
scripts.//iterate: ITERATION MODE (POD-2513, spec §7) — the web UI from source, hot-reloading, in front of the LIVE INSTALLED server rather than a second source backend. `host` is the laptop all-in-one and gives you an empty instance; `iterate` is how you change the UI on a machine whose data and agent sessions you actually want. Writes no dist, publishes no release, and frames the page so it can never be mistaken for the installed app. Foreground, never auto-started; see docs/iteration-mode.md.
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.unit.config.ts --project node --maxWorkers=1 packages/runtime/src/boot.test.ts apps/server/src/router.setup.test.ts apps/daemon/src/connection-state.test.ts scripts/test-configuration.test.ts --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:global-store-canary: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label test:global-store-canary -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.unit.config.ts --project node scripts/global-store-canary.test.ts scripts/typecheck.test.ts
scripts.//test:cached: Focused turbo-cache probes for the web and mobile package tasks. The default test command now routes every package-owned unit task through the same cache-safe wrapper, which refuses a cached green against a missing/dangling node_modules/@podium (POD-1343).
scripts.//test:rust: The desktop shell's Rust tests (native NDJSON sink, rotation, panic hook, crash hand-off). They ran in NO lane until POD-1906; see scripts/test-rust.ts for why cargo needs placeholder resources.
scripts.test:changed: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label test:changed -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --changed HEAD --passWithNoTests --config vitest.unit.config.ts --project node --project normalized-wire
scripts.test:related: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label test:related -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs related --passWithNoTests --config vitest.unit.config.ts --project node --project normalized-wire

scripts.test:perf:pty-transport: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts heavy --label test:perf:pty-transport -- bun --conditions=@podium/source scripts/pty-transport-benchmark.ts
scripts.test:supervisor: bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.integration.config.ts --maxWorkers=1 scripts/parent-supervised-stack.integration.test.ts -t 'discovers every supervised role'
scripts.test:integration: bun run build && bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.integration.config.ts --maxWorkers=1 && bun run test:acceptance
scripts.test:acceptance: bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.acceptance.config.ts
scripts.test:smoke:agents: PODIUM_REAL_CLI=1 bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.agent-smoke.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=@podium/source bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun --bun node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts --maxWorkers=1 tests/e2e

scripts.test:bun: bun scripts/test-heavy.ts -- bun test --conditions=@podium/source apps/daemon/test packages/runtime/test/sqlite.bun.test.ts scripts/lifecycle.integration.bun.test.ts --test-name-pattern ''
scripts.test:bun:unit: bun scripts/validation-admission.ts focused --label test:bun:unit -- bun test --conditions=@podium/source packages/runtime/test/sqlite.bun.test.ts --test-name-pattern ''

scripts.//release:cut: Cut a Podium release: bumps package.json, promotes the changelog's Unreleased section, commits, tags and pushes. `release` above is changesets publishing the workspace PACKAGES — a different thing entirely.
scripts.//release:prepare: THE ONE RELEASE ENTRY. Builds or restores web and mobile ONCE through scripts/build-clients.ts, then packages every requested platform from that single output in process. The CI release job runs it; the development publisher spawns the same scripts/release.ts --prepare-cross with its own --platform/--artifact pairs. Takes --platform (repeated, defaults to all four) and --artifact <platform>=<absolute path>.
